name: Donkey (South Indian)
description: Donkey (known as 'Kazhuda' in Tamil/Malayalam or 'Gaadida' in Telugu) is a popular shedding card game played in South India. Unlike many Western card games where winning a trick is desirable, in Donkey, the goal is simply to get rid of your cards. Failing to follow suit results in the 'Donkey' penalty: taking all the cards from the current trick into your hand.

content.text: Donkey (known as 'Kazhuda' in Tamil/Malayalam or 'Gaadida' in Telugu) is a popular shedding card game played in South India. Unlike many Western card games where winning a trick is desirable, in Donkey, the goal is simply to get rid of your cards. Failing to follow suit results in the 'Donkey' penalty: taking all the cards from the current trick into your hand.

Donkey is a localized variant of the international family of 'Get Away' or 'Spoons' games. It has been a staple in Indian households for generations, specifically across Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, and Karnataka.
All cards are dealt out as equally as possible. Some players may have one card more than others.
